verdict.rationale: Retell documents configurable per-agent data retention that automatically and permanently deletes call and chat data (transcripts, recordings, logs) after a set period, explicitly for compliance purposes. The pack shows nothing on per-call recording controls or consent and disclosure features, which are the core of the call-recording obligation in the story. Missing for 10: per-call recording on/off controls, consent/disclosure messaging or opt-out handling, per-call (rather than per-agent) retention, independent corroboration.
